# Gitee fixtures

Hand-authored from the Gitee Open API v5 Swagger description
(<https://gitee.com/api/v5/doc_json>, "Gitee Open API" 5.4.93), because no Gitee
token was available and anonymous reads of sample repositories returned
upstream errors. Every fixture is marked `handAuthored: true`.

Webhook payloads follow Gitee's documented hook format (`hook_name`,
`X-Gitee-Token`, `X-Gitee-Timestamp`) at help.gitee.com.
